title: Miles Davis at Newport 1958
studio_context: The sextet live at the Newport Jazz Festival, 3 July 1958, two months after Cobb joined; first issued as half of Miles & Monk at Newport (1964). Opens with Ah-Leu-Cha.

drum_performances.name: Jimmy Cobb
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Cobb 'at his fiery best' (Not So Modern Drummer): the ride and the foot on 2 and 4 under bebop, the snare and bass drum answering the horns in triplets, press rolls into the choruses.
